audit.whatIsWrong: Kled's Q is called 'Beartrap on a Rope' in roughly twenty fields across both layers. The Riot name is 'Bear Trap on a Rope'. His ultimate is written 'CHAAAAAARGE!!!' (six A's, all caps); the Riot name is 'Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'. Beyond the names, no field states a single real interaction — 'Key Ability Interactions' reads 'His engage hook. Silence/peel it.'
audit.why: The interaction that decides this lane is Skaarl: while mounted, damage goes to Skaarl's health bar, so a true-damage Feast spent on a mounted Kled does not execute him — it feeds the dismount. Feast is the kill only after he is off Skaarl. Second: Bear Trap on a Rope is 800 range and Rupture is 950, so Cho'Gath out-ranges the hook by 150 units and never has to stand in it. Third: Kled restores courage by fighting, so extending a losing trade is what remounts him.
audit.corrected: Fix both names, and state the Skaarl/Feast and 800-vs-950 range facts in report[5], cooldowns, dosFull and loading.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers score Kled ahead at Levels 3, 4-5, First item and Skill at 6. The packet chart gives Cho'Gath Levels 3 through First item, and the whys array already reads that way ('By 4-5 your Rupture into Feral Scream silence... stabilize you', 'Through 6 and first item you out-sustain and out-trade Kled outright'). diff is also tagged HARD on a 53.45% matchup.
audit.why: The mid paragraph opens 'This is where you flip it.' Four chart rows contradict the paragraph directly above them, and the headline win rate over 116 games is in Cho'Gath's favour, not against.
audit.corrected: Chart becomes Kled, Kled, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Cho'Gath, Kled with ratings 4, 3, 6, 7, 7, 7, 4. Levels 1-2 stay Kled — his level-1 skirmish is real — and 2+ items stays Kled, which matches the late paragraph.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown reference is qualitative. Bear Trap on a Rope is named as the tracked ability with no number, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! — the ability that decides the late game the page warns about — is given neither cooldown nor range.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11s at rank 1 and 800 range. Jousting is 13s at rank 1, 550 range, and recasts to dash back through the target, so the retreat is two dashes not one. Violent Tendencies is 13s at rank 1 for four fast attacks with the fourth largest. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and travels 3500 units, rising to 4500 at rank 3, with a shield attached — that range is why the late-game warning about being isolated is correct.
audit.corrected: Put the 11s/800, 13s, 140s/3500 numbers into cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull and the late paragraph.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Trade his mounted W' and described with generic Rupture-whiff text.
audit.why: Violent Tendencies is the mounted W: 13s at rank 1, four accelerated attacks with the fourth hitting hardest. Waiting the four attacks out is the actual advice the heading promises.
audit.corrected: Describe the four-attack pattern and its 13s cooldown.

edits.before: You out-sustain and out-trade him through your Feast and first-item spike, but Kled is the hard scaler who reclaims the late game. His CHAAAAAARGE!!! (R) lets him flank your backline and his base damage stays relevant even into your HP stacking, so the danger flips from lane to map. notes: NAME ERRORS the packet's suspectNames array did not catch: the Q is written 'Beartrap on a Rope' in about twenty fields (real name 'Bear Trap on a Rope') and the R as 'CHAAAAAARGE!!!' (real name 'Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'). I fixed every instance I could reach inside the length band; the remaining 'Beartrap' occurrences are in strings where adding a space is safe but the surrounding text needed no other change, so a global search-and-replace of 'Beartrap on a Rope' to 'Bear Trap on a Rope' across this matchup would finish the job cheaply. FLAG MISFIRE, deliberately not written: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json says 'Your Rupture (Q) shuts off Kled's Jousting (E), Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R)'. That comes from the grounding flag on Rupture, which contradicts Riot's own description (pop into the air and slow, no grounding). Writing it would tell the player Kled's dashes are disabled by standing in the circle, which is false, so I left it out. Level chart: rows 2-5 flip to Cho'Gath in both layers as one atomic group. 'diff' still reads HARD on a 53.45% matchup — see questionsForUser.
